answer: A bond is refunded only after 27 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The falcon counter is kept in prism and jade makes public each reset. Someone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 27 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2517 identities would post 1127 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
